mapper.insert: INSERT INTO triplej.payment ( order_id, payment_key, payment_amount, payment_status, payment_approved_at ) VALUES ( #{order_id}, #{payment_key}, #{payment_amount}, #{payment_status}, #{payment_approved_at} )

INSERT INTO triplej.orders ( member_id, order_total_amount, order_status, order_recipient_name, order_recipient_phone, order_zipcode, order_address, order_address_detail, order_delivery_msg, order_created_at ) VALUES ( #{member_id}, #{total_amount}, 'PAID', #{orderinfo.recipientName}, #{orderinfo.recipientMobilePhone}, #{orderinfo.recipientZipCode}, #{orderinfo.recipientFixAddress}, #{orderinfo.recipientDetailAddress}, #{orderinfo.orderMsgOption}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO triplej.order_item ( order_id, product_id, option_id, quantity, price, discount, total_price, purchase_type, cart_id ) VALUES ( #{order_id}, #{productId}, #{optionId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{discount}, #{totalPrice}, #{purchaseType}, #{cartId} )
